entities.summary: Edward Maurice Mezvinsky is an American politician and lawyer from Iowa. Mezvinsky is a former U.S. representative and felon. A member of the Democratic Party, he represented Iowa's 1st congressional district in the U.S. House of Representatives for two terms (1973–77).
